turns.question_text: Have you measured your blood pressure today? If so, what was the reading (for example 130/85)?
turns.why_text: Your blood pressure numbers tell your care team whether your treatment is keeping you protected.

turns.question_text: Before measuring, did you rest quietly for 5 minutes with your back supported and arm resting on a table?
turns.why_text: Resting quietly before measuring gives a much more accurate blood pressure reading.

turns.question_text: Do you have a severe headache, shortness of breath, ankle swelling, or dizziness when standing up?

turns.question_text: Have you taken any pain medicines (like ibuprofen), cold/cough syrups, or herbal supplements recently?

turns.question_text: Have you taken your prescribed blood pressure medications today?

turns.question_text: How has your sleep and stress level been, and have you had any salty food or alcohol recently?

turns.question_text: Are you fasting today (for Ramadan or another fast)?

turns.question_text: Is there anything else you would like your clinician to know about your health today?
